heroIntro: Give your AI agent your team’s way of working. Agree on what a feature should do, then use those same decisions to build and test it.
workflowIntro: The two loops can run at the same time. While you refine the spec with the client, the team can build and test a part you’ve already agreed on.
phaseTriggers: When a request is still open

workflowLoops.title: Build and deliver
workflowLoops.repeat: Adjust the implementation or build the next part

specFeedback.trigger: Does a finding from either loop change the agreement?

prototypeReview.label: Prototype UI
prototypeReview.title: Prototype, design and documentation side by side
prototypeReview.intro: A prototype gives an idea shape before you start building. You and the client can see whether the steps make sense and what might be missing. That gives you a chance to settle the remaining questions and refine the spec.
prototypeReview.setup: Use the prototype UI in your project
prototypeReview.imageAlt: The review environment showing a product comparison at phone size with its design spec alongside it.
prototypeReview.openDemo: Open this screen in the demo

whyTitle: How the spec helps the team
why: A decision from a demo goes into the spec first. The team can trace the agreed behaviour to the release that implements it.
During the review, the client saves a draft and reopens it. The team can see whether the last edit is still there.
An acceptance example describes what someone should see or do. The team uses that same example to build, test and review the change.
guidesIntro: Follow a feature from brief to release. Start a new project or add the feature to an existing application. Both tutorials use the same product comparison screen as their example.
catalogTitle: Find a skill for your task.
catalogIntro: Search by name or by what you want to do. Each skill includes an example prompt, the expected output and its installation command.
emptyHelp: Try another search term or choose a different phase.
installIntro: Run this command in your project directory. Choose your agent when prompted.
